description: Source code for autograd composite functions in PyTorch, including tensor operations such as _make_dual, _unpack_dual, _new_zeros_with_same_feature_meta, _has_same_storage_numel, and _lazy_clone, primarily used in inference mode and tensor manipulation.

methods.name: _make_dual
methods.description: Creates a dual tensor in inference mode, asserting inputs are inference tensors, and returns an alias of the primal tensor.

methods.name: _unpack_dual
methods.description: Unpacks a dual tensor to get its primal and tangent tensors, backward differentiable.

methods.name: _new_zeros_with_same_feature_meta
methods.description: Creates a new tensor with the same feature metadata as another tensor, considering batching dimensions.

methods.name: _has_same_storage_numel
methods.description: Checks if two tensors have the same number of storage elements.

methods.name: _lazy_clone
methods.description: Performs a lazy clone of a tensor's storage, used for efficient copying.
